scripts.text:
[Amachang]
Welcome to ^8B4513Amatsu^000000,
the town of kind towners
and beautiful cherry blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
歡迎來到^8B4513櫻花城^000000，這裡櫻花爛漫，居民熱情友善。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
I'm Amachang,
the 13th Miss Amatsu.
I will guide you about town
as Miss Amatsu.
Please tell me
if you want to know something.
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
我是第13屆櫻花城小姐阿瑪暢。
作為櫻花城小姐，我會為您介紹這座城鎮。
有什麼想了解的，儘管問吧。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
點選^B9062F[地點名稱]^000000，便可獲得最先進的^B9062F導航^000000服務！
